description: Lists public CMBS trusts, most distressed first (share of balance delinquent or with the special servicer), optionally filtered by a name fragment such as Benchmark or 2021. Use it to find a trust's slug or to see which deals are most distressed; use get_trust for one deal. No match returns an empty list.

limit.description: Up to 25 without a key, 400 with one

name: list_trusts

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation listTrusts). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

capped.description: Present and true on the free plan when the list stopped at the plan limit.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

note.description: Present with capped: sentence stating the plan's list limit.

results.description: Matching trusts, ordered by the share of their balance that is specially serviced or delinquent, highest first.

bal.description: Outstanding balance of those notes, dollars (includes carried notes).

carriedBal.description: Dollars: the balance of those carried notes, included in bal.

carriedN.description: Count of notes of this trust that its latest asset file leaves out while its 10-D still reports them (carried from an earlier file; they have no current status).

cik.description: The trust's SEC CIK number, as a string without leading zeros.

dlqBal.description: Balance of the trust's notes whose loan is delinquent (30+ days late or matured and not paid off), dollars; carried notes excluded.

filed.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the trust's latest asset file (Form ABS-EE) was filed; for an older trust with no asset file, its 10-D.

n.description: Count of the trust's notes (its pieces of loans) on file, including notes carried from an earlier asset file.

nightly.description: True for a trust the nightly refresh picked up since the monthly build: its balance and distress are from its loans; parties, certificate classes and losses come with the next monthly build.

note.description: Says what a nightly trust has and lacks (see nightly).

period.description: Latest reporting period end date among the trust's notes (YYYY-MM-DD).

special.description: The trust's own special servicer as its latest trustee report names it (same as parties.special at the monthly build); null when the report settles none or the trust was picked up by the nightly...

src.description: URL of that filing's index page on SEC EDGAR.

ssBal.description: Balance of the trust's notes whose loan is with the special servicer, dollars; carried notes excluded.

total.description: Count of trusts that match the query, before the limit.

title: List CMBS trusts
